question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

138, 137, 140, 139, 142, ?
solution:
Logic : Alternately (1) and (3) are subtracted and added respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15c6d62fbc3bd2364a79745184e4d9cfdf4a27c0749b1cad37c624b30d17f222.png] 

Hence, "141" is the correct answer.
